title: Quark Double Slabs
description: Adds unique double slab textures to blocks from Quark and Vanilla Minecraft!
body:
Adds double slab textures to blocks from the [Quark](https://modrinth.com/mod/quark) mod and vanilla Minecraft!\
\
Currently includes the following slabs:
## Vanilla
* Smooth Stone (Updated)
* Polished Deepslate
* Polished Blackstone
* Polished Granite, Andesite, Diorite
* Quartz
* Sandstone, Red Sandstone
* Cut Sandstone, Cut Red Sandstone
## Quark
* Polished Tuff, Calcite, Dripstone
* Polished Limestone, Jasper, Shale
* Polished Myalite
* Iron Plate, Rusty Iron Plate
##
\
_Quark is a mod by Vazkii, and Quark Double Slabs is a Resource Pack by Sorcell_
